summary: Research/posts tested against the environment-derived public origin with five isolated roles and real managed file storage. Final API results: 20/21 unique tests passed. Full browser research intake/quote/claim/work/payment/revision/completion, posts CRUD/moderation, draft recovery and cancellation passed. Two unresolved application issues: employee financial-note leak and severe research long-title overflow. No application files changed; cleanup verified.

critical.issue: Assigned employee receives the admin's private cancellation settlement note verbatim in events, including quote currency/amount, paid and remaining amounts. Reproduced twice. This violates employees' non-financial view.

ui_bugs.issue: A valid title under the 180-character limit containing a long unbroken Arabic word expands the heading beyond the viewport. document widths: 1848 at 390px, 2017 at 1000px, 2441 at 1920px. Mobile/tablet screenshots can appear entirely blank because RTL content lies off-screen.

integration_issues.issue: ResearchDetail renders all returned event notes, so the API cancellation-settlement leak is also exposed in employee UI.

action_items: Keep cancellation settlement/admin financial notes out of employee events. Mark financial actions appropriately AND protect historical events already saved with financial=false; retain a safe work-state event if needed.
Constrain PageHeading flex children with min-width:0/max-width and break long title tokens (overflow-wrap:anywhere); verify 390, 1000 and 1920px research details and payments rows.
Rerun financial privacy regression and long-title browser checks after fixes. Preserve actual accounts, settings, course publication and owner invitation.
critical_code_review_comments: research_actions.py calls change_request for all cancellation actions without financial=True, while research_core.py filters employee events only on that flag. Admin reject_cancel explicitly accepts external-settlement notes; therefore filtering by financial flag alone is insufficient for existing rows.
Shared PageHeading renders unrestricted h1 content; research file names already wrap correctly, but heading text does not. This is the demonstrated overflow source, not the file list/sidebar.

success_rate.frontend: Not numerically aggregated: executed functional workflows passed; long-title research layout failed at all three tested widths.

test_credentials: Credential file read before auth. No active credentials existed; generated isolated accounts only. All removed and manifest deleted. No invitation consumed and no email sent.
seed_data_creation: Cleanup removed 5 users, 31 sessions, 18 research requests, 18 posts, 36 comments, 3 reactions, 27 file metadata rows, 1 course, 1 lecture, 1 purchase and 203 isolated audit rows. Original settings and pre-existing course published states verified intact. Provider objects cannot be physically deleted; metadata removal revokes access. Shared rate-limit buckets left to expire.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run core test_research_posts.py first; it retains an isolated manifest for browser tests. Execute research_browser_regression.run and posts_browser_regression.run with BASE from frontend/.env and manifest. Then run followup module and cleanup script. Followup UI diagnostic assumes posts browser was executed. Browser source is directly executed by automation using exec(Path(...).read_text()) and await run, not merely defined. No mocks. Cookies/header protection, unauthorized research/file access, exclusive concurrent claim (200/409), revoke on return/reopen, withheld owner result IDs/downloads, student15%/visitor0 discounts, stale/rejected quote history, real partial/full receipts, prepayment, one revision, cancellation financial preservation, actual pagination12/6/15, public/private image boundaries, blocked users, safe XSS, course payment/private-file regression all exercised. Image-removal initial failure was a forced-click modal-animation artifact: ordinary click succeeded and persisted null image_id; final posts rerun passed. Initial followup expectation that reassigned workers must upload their own new file was corrected: approved requirement permits any uploaded current-round result. Existing same-round files are reused; not reported as a requirement failure. Long unbroken research title and financial-note leak remain unresolved. No unrelated load/email/subscription tests.
rca of the issue: Privacy reproduction: create/accept/claim a request; owner requests cancellation; admin reject_cancel note includes financial settlement; assigned employee GET research detail exposes note in events. research_actions.py final change_request omits financial=True, and visible_research employee branch preserves every event with financial false. Layout reproduction: submit a valid title with roughly140 unbroken Arabic characters; h1 overflow-wrap is normal and its flex ancestor has no shrink constraint, producing1830px heading width on390px screen. Suggested mitigation: employee-safe cancellation event serialization plus legacy protection; constrain/wrap shared heading without suppressing legitimate content.
